_doc: Owner-edited (never generated). One row per photo file in beta/assets/img/photos/. A photo renders on a beta card ONLY when its file exists here AND its row is complete (TASL: title/depicts, author, source, licence + licence URL); the build refuses any photo without a complete row, any non-free licence (NC/ND), any closed place and any place in Vietnam (no freedom of panorama). Candidates: beta/assets/img/manifest.json. How-to: design/beta/IMAGERY.md (Dropping in photos).

schema.record: { page: beta page key (e.g. "tokyo"), id: stable place id (e.g. "senso-ji") } — the place the photo depicts
schema.title: optional: the work's title as on its source page (defaults to depicts)
schema.depicts: what the photo shows, in words ("Sensō-ji main hall from the Hōzōmon gate")
schema.author: the creator exactly as the source credits them
schema.sourceUrl: https URL of the file's own page (e.g. its Wikimedia Commons file page)
schema.licence: short licence name: CC0 1.0 | Public domain | CC BY 4.0 | CC BY-SA 4.0 (… any version; NC/ND refused) | Unsplash License (licenceUrl https://unsplash.com/license, sourceUrl an unsplash.com/photos/… page; caption "Photo by <name> on Unsplash")
schema.licenceUrl: https URL of the licence deed
schema.modified: optional: what you changed ("cropped", "resized") — BY-SA adaptations stay BY-SA
schema.width: optional: pixel width (read from the file when omitted)
schema.height: optional: pixel height (read from the file when omitted)
schema.slot: instead of record, for a hub hero or a generic collection cover: { type: "hero" | "cover", key: page/country or collection key } — Unsplash rows from tools/beta/imagery/fetch-unsplash.js
